description.zh: 是否自动接入云安全中心、Web应用防火墙、云防火墙的告警日志，默认自动接入。
description.en: Specifies whether to automatically add alert logs from Security Center, Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Cloud Firewall. By default, alert logs are automatically added.

description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region of the Data Management center for Threat Analysis. Select the region based on where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in regions outside China.

description.zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID。
description.en: The user ID of a member. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the perspective of the specified member.

description.zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图。
description.en:
The type of the view.

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all member accounts.
